map.年折旧 = (原值−残值)×剩余年数/年数总和: Annual depreciation = (original cost − residual value) × remaining years / sum of years
map.希望在早期多提折旧、后期少提，匹配资产效用递减。: To take more depreciation early and less later, matching the declining utility of the asset.
map.与双倍余额递减法同为加速折旧，但递减更平缓、可控。: Like the double-declining-balance method it is accelerated depreciation, but the decline is gentler and more controllable.
map.税法允许时用于递延纳税，平滑各期税负。: Where tax law allows, use it to defer tax and smooth the burden across periods.
map.年数总和法首年折旧: First-year depreciation under the sum-of-years'-digits method
map.：某设备原值 100 万元、残值 10 万元、年限 5 年，年数总和=5+4+3: : an asset with original cost 1 million, residual value 100000 and 5-year life has a sum of years' digits of 5+4+3+2+1=15. Year 1 depreciation rate = 5/15, depreciation = (100−10)×5/15 = 300000 CNY; year 2 = (100−10)×4/15 = 240000 CNY, declining year by year.
map.由营收、营业成本与费用求 EBIT: EBIT from revenue, operating cost and expenses
map.由经营现金流与资本支出求自由现金流: Free cash flow from operating cash flow and capital expenditure
map.年数总和法与双倍余额递减法有何区别？: How does the sum-of-years'-digits method differ from the double-declining-balance method?
map.前者折旧率=剩余年数/年数总和、基数固定为(原值−残值)，递减线性；后者以率乘账: The straight-line method has depreciation rate = remaining years / sum of years, with a fixed base of (original cost − residual value), declining linearly; the accelerated methods multiply a rate by book value, are faster early on, and do not deduct residual value early.
map.年数总和法的基数含残值吗？: Does the base of the sum-of-years'-digits method include residual value?
map.含。年数总和法以(原值−预计净残值)为折旧基数，按逐年下降的权重分摊，到期净值恰: Included. The sum-of-years'-digits method uses (original cost − expected net residual value) as the base and allocates it by decreasing weights, so the ending net value equals the residual value exactly.
